title: Peloton Yoga Class Output Leaderboard
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=peloton:yoga output_kj=*
| stats sum(output_kj) as total_value, avg(output_kj) as avg_value by instructor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks instructor values by total and average output across Peloton yoga class events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `output_kj` values for each Peloton yoga class event and review total and average output by instructor.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total output.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which instructor shows the biggest output numbers in your Peloton yoga class data.
